beats.say: You've seen the girl on your Nirma packet a thousand times, but you never asked why she's there. Why?
Nineteen sixty-nine, Gujarat. A chemist, Karsanbhai Patel, mixes washing powder at home after office hours.
lines: a chemist with a government job
makes powder at home after office

beats.say: He sells it door to door, on his bicycle. Three rupees fifty a kilo, when Surf cost thirteen.
Then it needed a name. He chose his daughter's. Nirupama. At home, they called her Nirma.
Here's the part nobody tells you. Nirupama died young, in an accident.
So he put her on every packet. The girl in the white frock is a father's tribute. Full story on our channel.
